title: The pullback on etale cohomology is well defined and functorial
statement:
For a morphism of schemes $u:Y\to X$ and an abelian sheaf $G$ on $X_{\Et}$, let $u^*:H^q(X_{\Et},G)\to H^q(Y_{\Et},u^{-1}G)$ be the pullback map of [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback]. Then:

1. $u^*$ does not depend on the choice of the resolutions $G\to I^\bullet$ and $u^{-1}I^\bullet\to J^\bullet$, once the cohomology groups are identified through [prop-weil-pbc-cohomology-resolution-independent]; the same holds for $u^*$ on $\RGamma$ of a bounded below complex.
2. (Any comparison complex.) If $G\to I^\bullet$ is an injective resolution, $u^{-1}G\to M^\bullet$ is any quasi-isomorphism to a bounded below complex, and $\beta:u^{-1}I^\bullet\to M^\bullet$ a morphism of complexes under $u^{-1}G$, then $u^*$ followed by the canonical map $H^q(Y,u^{-1}G)\to\mathcal H^q(\Gamma(Y,M^\bullet))\to\ldots$ is computed by $a\mapsto\beta(\eta_u(a))$; in particular, if $M^\bullet$ is itself a resolution of $u^{-1}G$ by injective (or $\Gamma(Y,-)$-acyclic) sheaves, $u^*$ is $\mathcal H^q$ of $\Gamma(X,I^\bullet)\to\Gamma(Y,M^\bullet)$, $a\mapsto\beta(\eta_u(a))$.
3. (Naturality.) For a morphism $\varphi:G\to G'$, $u^*\circ H^q(\varphi)=H^q(u^{-1}\varphi)\circ u^*$.
4. (Composition.) For $v:Z\to Y$, let $c_{u,v}:v^{-1}u^{-1}\xrightarrow{\sim}(u\circ v)^{-1}$ be the canonical isomorphism (the left adjoints of $(u\circ v)_*=u_*\circ v_*$ [def-weil-pbc-direct-image] being unique up to unique isomorphism compatible with the units). Then $(u\circ v)^*=H^q(c_{u,v,G})\circ v^*\circ u^*:H^q(X,G)\to H^q(Z,(u\circ v)^{-1}G)$, and $\mathrm{id}_X^*=\mathrm{id}$.
5. (Etale maps.) If $u$ is etale, then $u^*$ is computed by restricting the sections of an injective resolution $I^\bullet$ of $G$ to $Y$: $I^\bullet|_Y$ is an injective resolution of $G|_Y$.

source.place: Section Tag 01F7 (section-functoriality): Lemma Tag 01F8 (functoriality in the triple), Remark Tag 01FB (remark-explain-arrow, independence of the choices); for (5) literature/stacks-project/sites-cohomology.tex Lemma Tag 03F3 (lemma-cohomology-of-open) and the restriction of injectives to a localization; written in Stacks for ringed spaces and ringed sites, the etale case being the same argument
